cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(wuji_hand_driver)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(catkin REQUIRED COMPONENTS roscpp sensor_msgs std_msgs std_srvs diagnostic_msgs)
catkin_package()
option(WUJI_WITH_SDK "Build physical USB backend" ON)
add_executable(wuji_hand_driver_node src/driver.cpp)
target_include_directories(wuji_hand_driver_node PRIVATE include ${catkin_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(wuji_hand_driver_node ${catkin_LIBRARIES} pthread)
if(WUJI_WITH_SDK)
  find_path(WUJI_INCLUDE wujihandcpp/device/hand.hpp)
  find_library(WUJI_LIBRARY wujihandcpp)
  if(NOT WUJI_INCLUDE OR NOT WUJI_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Install wujihandcpp 1.5.1 or build with WUJI_WITH_SDK=OFF")
  endif()
  target_include_directories(wuji_hand_driver_node PRIVATE ${WUJI_INCLUDE})
  target_link_libraries(wuji_hand_driver_node ${WUJI_LIBRARY})
  target_compile_definitions(wuji_hand_driver_node PRIVATE WUJI_WITH_SDK)
endif()
if(CATKIN_ENABLE_TESTING)
  catkin_add_gtest(wuji_spline_test test/spline_test.cpp)
  if(TARGET wuji_spline_test)
    target_include_directories(wuji_spline_test PRIVATE include)
  endif()
endif()
install(TARGETS wuji_hand_driver_node RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CATKIN_PACKAGE_BIN_DESTINATION})
